proposal.hypothesis: Static scheduling of the outer row loop assigns disjoint, contiguous output rows with uniform work while preserving the existing r-c-k accumulation order. A per-call thread cap of min(max(threads, 1), 8, n) tests scaling without changing global OpenMP state. Matrices below 128 remain serial to avoid team-startup overhead; this cutoff is a hypothesis to measure, not a demonstrated speedup.

retained: Parallelize the existing outer row loop with OpenMP schedule(static), assigning each row to one worker and retaining the original c-then-k loop order.
Set the per-call team size to min(max(threads, 1), 8, n); avoid entering a parallel region for sizes below 128 or when only one worker is requested.
Retain output zeroing and the original accumulation form; add a generic-size fallback while preserving compile-time paths for 32, 128, and 1024.
